newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy DPEF to have pension reform outlines - Veltron.
newsitem.headline: Italy DPEF to have pension reform outlines - Veltron.

text.p: The Italian government's three year economic plan (DPEF) will contain "clear guidelines" on planned reform of pensions spending, deputy Prime Minister Walter Veltroni said, confirming the document will be ready next week.

"In the next few days there will be a meeting of majority parties on pensions and then with unions and employers, Veltroni told reporters while attending the annual congress of the CISL trade union confederation.
"We're on the home straight. With the DPEF the guidelines will be clear," he added.
Prime Minister Romano Prodi's cabinet had been due to examine the document later this week but the date has been put off until early next week.

The long-awaited programme of rolling targets for 1998-2000, expected to give indications of savings the government hopes to make from crucial welfare state reforms and including new 1998 deficit forecasts, will be used as the basis for Italy's convergence plan for early membership of the single European currency.
